results.title: Mario Builder 64
results.description:
Mario Builder 64 is a toolbox letting you fulfill all of your SM64 dreams. Play one of the numerous user-made levels, or create a course pushing your imagination (and hardware) to its limits!

Play!

It's never been easier to access new SM64 content. Just by reading from an SD card, the game can play any user-generated level that catches your eye. Whether you love #retro throwbacks or kaizo platforming, you can count on community levels to fill any and every niche. Can't find anything you like? Good thing you can...

Build!

Let your ideas spill onto the canvas, one block at a time. The level editor is easy to pick up, but offers a lot of depths to advanced users - whether you're making a speedrun level, an 8-star course or an 8-bit calculator, the palette of over 100 parts will suit your needs.

The levels are endlessly customizable, with a vast selection of music, a theme editor for committed designers and an expanded interaction system ready to support any contraptions your mind envisions!

Beyond Vanilla

The 'Beyond the Cursed Mirror' theme lets you build levels using mechanics from the creator's eponymous major hack. Uncover the 'Badge' system, offering the player permanent, unlockable powerups, or utilize parts taken from the hack, such as the ever-endearing Showrunner boss!

Setup Guide

https://rentry.co/mb64-setup-guide

results.title: Mystery of the Capsmith Demo
results.description:
The demo for Mystery of the Capsmith is here!
3 new caps, 3 new levels!

I made this game in 17 days for the Scuttle Hacking Competition and it won first place. This shorter competition/demo version doesn't have the story of the Capsmith, but the full version will. You can let me know what you think of it, and if you'd like to see it made into a larger hack or even a major hack.
This demo does not support N64 as its build doesn't have my newer optimizations.

If using PJ64, make sure 'Sync game to Audio' is checked, otherwise you may encounter tempo and/or looping problems with the music. If you find these same problems with the music when using ParaLLEl, please let me know which plug-in you were using.

results.title: Serene Fusion
results.description:

results.title: Shotgun Mario 64
results.description:
Blast your way through good ol' Mario 64 with a SHOTGUN!  A completely new shotgun mechanic complete with firing, a jump-boost, an aiming mode with a crosshair, and many unique interactions to make for a fresh SM64 experience.  This initial version game took around 200 hours of work to make.
Be sure to check back regularly, as I update this game pretty often!  From new interactions & bug fixes to completely new dynamics.

* Use ParaLLEl with its native graphics plug-in,  otherwise you will encounter graphical issues.  If you can't use ParaLLEl's default plug-in for whatever reason, use GlideN64

* I'm not working on making this better on N64, don't play it on there, it's unstable

Note for speedrunners: hold R, Z and B during the intro to skip the tutorial

results.title: SM64: Decades Later
results.description:
Ever wondered what SM64's levels would look like after a few years, maybe even 2 decades after the events the original when Bowser took over the Castle with now 150 new stars to collect?
Well, this hack aims to recreate and reimagine vanilla SM64 levels from memory to an extend where some levels will feel familiar yet new and others that have been turned into fully new levels.
Stars or sections that felt too repetitive or just weren't fun in the eyes of the hack creator have been replaced with newer stars or been reworked to play out differently.

So in short, don't expect this to be a 1 to 1 remake of sm64.

If you desire new stuff, the endgame close to 100% is filled with new original stages.

Good luck and have fun!

Make sure to download this Zip as well for extra stuff that can't come with the normal download.
Extras ZIP: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1XKUKy6bxhoJtfvNhI-TnQzhRfrVkcRKH/view

Credits can be found ingame on a sign, but still special thanks to aglab2 for all the custom coding.

Changes of 1.1h2:
- Fixed course 2 related crashes

Main changes of V1.1:
- Made certain stars non-stop
- Fixed a few smaller Problems in some of the levels
- Changed some textboxes
- Made the radars stronger on the Y-axis in non-vertical levels
- Ingame star display will now default to the floor you are on rather than 2nd floor being the default
- The Camera will now try to keep up with Mario when moving on the Y-axis, as long as it doesn't get stuck on a ledge
- Fail Warp won't force a new camera angle based on the direction mario faced when falling off anymore
- Panel Stars, Red Coin Stars, Bosses/Stars from Bosses should now all respawn in one way or another when you change areas within the same level

tags: SMW Trolls Make us Laugh Troll Contest
results.description:
A game that punishes you for trying to go fast. But who says you can't?

Made in HackerSM64, created for SMW Trolls "Make us Laugh Troll Contest".
This hack is meant to be accessible, but its humor is mostly targeted towards people in the SM64 community.

V1.0.2 recommended! It has some very small but very necessary QoL improvements.
Edit: Don't use the first "Play Now" button; use the version-specific buttons instead. By default, "Play Now" is supposed to give the first version listed, but DGR (one of the competition's judges) got V0.9 instead.

For streaming, keep the top left corner empty if you can. Unless you hate reading, which is understandable. Also, ping me on Discord like a million times, 'cause I want to get people's reactions SO bad.
(@supersoupgalaxy. I'm also in the Any Game Troll Contest discord.)

Inputs Needed:

	Every N64 controller input, including L-button and D-pad controls,
	which aren't normally used.

	L is the reset button.
	The d-pad buttons are used to make micro-adjustments to the camera.
	A/B/Z are all used for swimming.



Target: Parallel Launcher. Please use this to play the hack.
Most of the following settings should be automated:

	Graphics Plugin: GLideN64 (This will *probably* work fine.
	But if not, feel free to try the other plugins.)

		Overclock CPU: ON
		Overclock VI: OFF
		Emulate Framebuffer: ON
		Emulate N64 Depth Compare: ON
		Widescreen (Viewport Hack): OFF

	Alternatively, if you use ParaLLel as the graphics plugin:

		Remove Black Borders: ON

	Input Mode: Normal
	Widescreen (Stretched): OFF
	Use Interpreter Core: OFF
	16kb EEPROM: OFF
	LLE RSP: OFF



V0.9 was submitted a day before the deadline, and is the playtest version. A lot of things were changed between this and V1.0.

V1.0 was submitted 4 hours before, and is the version submitted at the time of the deadline.

V1.0.1 was submitted 3 days later. It adds QoL that I considered to be necessary.

V1.0.2 was submitted 24 days later. It fixes a bug in V1.0.1 where a certain spike wouldn't load properly.
(I wasn't able to fix it sooner because my main PC was MIA.)

results.title: Mario in the Multiverse
results.description:
Enter the Multiverse

As Professor E. Gadd’s Multiverse Machine malfunctions, spacetime itself fractures! Fifteen realities collide, with the only hope of undoing this disaster being a wish upon the center of all things.

From the haunting undersea city of Rapture to the rolling hills of Johto, MitM will take you on a ride through stages from the furthest corners of the Multiverse. Each with its own abilities and challenges, and each bringing you closer to reaching Atreus...

Multiversatile

Mario is armed to the teeth with abilities. With everything from precognitive drugs to high-caliber guns at your disposal, the sky is the limit. Every ability opens new routes and challenges in its home level as well as in many others.

Every obstacle is an opportunity to express yourself by discovering your own solutions - with over 120 stars to obtain, you’ll have plenty of time to experiment with combos and synergies between the abilities!

A Labor of Love

Mario in the Multiverse is a Collaborative Major Hack brought to you by an all-star team of ROMhackers, each representing a given series through a unique level and ability to make this a journey like no other.

Through cooperation and critique, the hack has become more than the sum of its parts – it’s a cohesive experience where seemingly disconnected elements can interact in novel and interesting ways.

results.title: Celestio 64 (Demo)
results.description:
Huge thanks to Arthurtilly, Reonu, ArcticJaguar725, someone2639, Wiseguy, and The Sour OG, for testing, tools, and advice.

This is Celestio 64! I have ported over the physics code (and more) from Celeste's public codebase. It runs at 60fps, physics and visuals, on both emulator and console!

Controls are much like Celeste, and you can either use controller stick or D-Pad to move/dash.

This was made with widescreen in mind. In the main/pause menu, you can turn Widescreen on or off, which will either vertically stretch the image or add bars to the top and bottom. So in your emulator settings, you can switch the aspect ratio to 16/9 and it should properly stretch it out in Widescreen mode.

This game was made to support rumble!
Either set your emulator settings to enable rumble, or use it on console.
Note: For the time being you will need to make sure that rumble is plugged in or enabled before the game boots!

results.title: SM64 POWER STAR MADNESS
results.description:
✮ I present to you my humble Super Mario 64 ROM Hack. This is a full length hack featuring many stars to collect!

✮ This is my first ROM Hack, so expect it having some issues. I really tested a LOT in order to make sure the least amount of bugs remain. But even with that, probably more than one slipped through the cracks. Sorry in advance for that!

✮ This hack was primarly tested using Project64 1.6 with Jabo's Direct3D8 1.6, DirectSound 1.6 and DirectInput7 1.6.
- GlideN64 should work too as I tested sometimes with it.
- Also should work on Mupen, but you need to select the dynamic interpreter. 
- Other emulators probably are fine, but those are which I'm sure. Make sure to enable 8MB size on emulator settings.
- Also booted up in parellel launcher to see if works with OGRE plugin (as I'm writing this, didn't know you needed to test it in a specific emulator D;) It seems to works fine with minor graphical issues. But following the flowchart, the optimal should be GlideN64.

✮ I hope you like it and have fun! :D

✮✮QoL Version✮✮
I made this little update thanks to the feedback of the people c:
The Quality of Life version includes:
- parallel lakitu camera 
- removed lives system (1-ups and 3-ups still there as a fun challenge to collect, now heals Mario)
- removed fall damage (makes 1 star easier, which is great)

So basically, choose the QoL version or the original at will :)

*complete info in the trailer video*

results.description:
“Greetings Superstar,
Did you know that your nemesis hid in the decrepit castle all this time?
It appears he fosters his strength in a hidden compartment behind one cursed mirror.
I implore you to defeat him, once and for all – for the sake of the kingdom.

results.title: Super Cream 64
results.description:
"On the week before her daughter's birthday, Vanilla wonders how to surprise her daughter this year. The answer? Rent a huge castle, redecorate it and have a bit of fun"

A visual and audio overhaul of SM64 starring Cream & Cheese. The following changes include:

- The ability to fly! Originally made for Cream 64, introduced in Chao Bandstand and now it's finally back in its intended hack. Works like Sonic Heroes: get about 3-4 seconds of total flight time. When you're not moving, you lose no stamina.
- Be whoever you wanna be! A various set of outfits available for you to pick from from the very start! 
- Brand new levels replacing five existing levels: Secret Aquarium, Tower of the Wing Cap, Vanish Cap under the Moat, Cavern of the Metal Cap and Wing Mario over the Rainbow. Each still have a single secret star and their respective cap switches are still there too. The Princess' Secret Slide remains the same but now has a visual makeover.
- Models and textures have been updated to fit the theme, ranging from enemies, the various toads in the castle, stars, etc. The few untouched are left that way on purpose.
- Music has been updated. All but a few have been replaced with brand new tracks.
- General tweaks to the speed for the Koopa the Quick replacement. Rematch is now more doable than how it was in v4.x
- Amy, Tails, Blaze and Marine have their own little side stories. Completely optional and located through the game in the various levels. Keep an eye out!
- And so much more.

Full patch notes for v6 available here: https://gbgamebun.tumblr.com/post/756756672859553792/super-cream-64-v6-update-patch-notes

Alongside the original N64 port, you can also play SC64 natively on PC and 3DS! Links down below:

results.title: Gamma64
results.description:
A fresh new take on SM64, with many early concepts from the game's development.

Playing on real hardware? Here's how to get saves working:

Summercart:
First, on the console itself, navigate to the menu right before the game loads up (The one where you press A to load the ROM)
Then, press R on your controller, and select "Set save type".
Finally, select the EEPROM 4kbit save format.

ED64:
Insert the entry "0x8D3BD49B=1 (Gamma64_V1.10)" in your save_db.txt when playing on real hardware.

Other Flash Carts:
Set the EEPROM save type to "EEPROM 4kbit/512byte".

results.title: Super Mario Galaxy 2 3: Impossible Hak 2
results.description:
The word “lobotomy” refers to several brain surgeries that break connections between the frontal lobe and different parts of the brain. The frontal lobe is involved in many brain processes, including language, voluntary motion, and many cognitive abilities.

The different types of lobotomy include:
• topectomy, in which a surgeon removes parts of the frontal lobe
• leucotomy or leukotomy, in which a surgeon severs connections between the frontal lobe and the thalamus
• neuro-injection of sclerosing agents, in which a surgeon injects drugs that harden the fibers connecting the frontal lobe to the thalamus

results.title: Move Your Body Freely 64
results.description:
This is a movement modification made ontop of vanilla SM64. It allows many moves to be cancelled into eachother and has special considerations made for conservation of momentum. The changes are as follows :

Conservation of momentum is increased for running and walking, so if you gain excess speed,
you'll be able to run around very quickly with it for awhile. Similarly, swimming speed
has a higher cap. Sliding friction is altered to allow sliding to continue for longer,
this results in massive speed gains on slippery surfaces, and moderate momentum conservation
on regular surfaces.

You can cancel many moves into eachother:
Long jump can be cancelled into dive or groundpound
Dive and divekick can be cancelled into rollout midair
Rollout can be cancelled into a groundpound
Groundpound can be cancelled into a divekick (once per airtime)
Ground pound landing can be cancelled into a divekick or an instant triple jump
Backflip can be cancelled into an any-time twirl (with B)

Divekicks can now be wall jumped out of.
Ground pounds now have a 'speed pound' version, where if you're over a certain
speed threshold, they no longer stop your forward momentum. These automatically
land into a speedy divekick.
Ground pounds can now be wall jumped out of.
Ceilings can now be grabbed out of a rollout.
Rollouts now instantly reflect off of walls, maintaining your momentum but
disallowing walljumps.

Long jumps and dives no longer set your speed, they instead only increase
your speed if you're below their max desired speed thresholds. This way you can
now dive or long jump at high speeds without losing all your speed.

Swim 'power' is increased, you now can swim at very fast speeds, but also your speed as you enter the water is better carried, allowing yourself to bullet through pools. You can now dive or ground pound when leaping out of the water, opening up some more movement options due to the 'combo system'.


Non-stop star gain is enabled. Text on the first sign and the final Bowser is altered.

You can press "L" for a speed display.

Yoshi's spelling mistake is fixed (ha ha).

Ceiling clamber controls are improved (baseline in HackerSM64)

Made with HackerSM64 decomp.

Thanks, hope you enjoy!

-B

results.title: Super Mario 64 Widescreen (console-friendly)
results.description:
This is vanilla SM64 but it has widescreen support. It will switch to 16:9 automatically once you select a file, and you can toggle it in the pause menu with L. It renders at the same internal resolution as vanilla, so it doesn't require the expansion pak and it shouldn't have extra lag (in fact, it should have LESS lag than vanilla since it's compiled with GCC and O2). However this also means that the HUD will be stretched.

A .map file is provided in case it's useful to anyone.

results.title: Super Birdo 64
results.description:
A vanilla edit that lets you play as Birdo!

Features:
- Custom model by yours truly.
- All Mario voice clips replaced by Birdo voice clips from modern Mario games.
- NEW IN V2.0: Completely custom animations! 120 of Mario's original animations have been replaced by new ones more fitting for Birdo (+30 minor adjustments to existing animations).
- NEW IN V2.0: A Color Preset system, with a wide range of presets and colors available for customization from the get go! Unlock new colors for Birdo by getting specific stars, and mix and match unlocked colors to create your very own custom preset. Bow, Skin, Back Spikes, Belly and Claws can each have their own color.
- Custom HUD and additional textures. All Mario-related elements/textures have been replaced with Birdo ones.
- An Egg Shooting Mechanic.

Egg Shooting:

By pressing the L-Trigger, you can toggle "Shoot Mode", which allows you to shoot eggs with the B-Button. While in Shoot Mode, all B-Button actions are replaced with Egg Shooting. Eggs can be used to beat small foes, break boxes and collect coins, between a few other things! Feel free to experiment to find ways to make the most out of them.

"C-Up mode" has been replaced with First Person Mode. In this mode, while Shoot Mode is active, a reticle will display allowing you to shoot eggs wherever you aim it.

Also while in Shoot Mode, pressing the R-Trigger will toggle Targetting, which is represented by an X-shaped reticle appearing next to the Camera HUD icons. While Targetting is active, Birdo will auto-aim at any enemy marked by the reticle, making it easier to shoot 'em up!

**NEW IN V2.0**
Color Preset Menu:

To access the Preset Menu, pause the game and press the R-Trigger. The Menu provides instructions on how to change presets and individual colors. There's one Custom Preset slot for you to freely modify: You can use any of the default colors available as well as any colors obtained from Unlockable Presets, and save your Custom Preset to use it whenever you like. Your Custom Preset will be saved to your File, so don't worry about it being overriden when making a new save.

Note: Not all colors from an Unlockable Preset are usable from the get go. Some of the unlockable colors are shared between presets and may require you to unlock specific presets in order to use them on your Custom Preset

Enjoy!

_____________________________________________________

PS:

This is my first romhack. It was made as a gift for my girlfriend, for Birdo is her favorite Nintendo Character; and, through the creation of this hack, I grew very fond of her as well.

If you're a Birdo fan like us, I hope you have fun replaying the original Super Mario 64 with her.

If you play this just out of curiosity, I hope it helps you grow fond of Birdo as I did.

I hope I can make original Birdo-themed adventures in the near future.

Thanks for downloading, or just for checking this page out!

____________________________________

"Cover" Art by my beloved CorruptedUnicorn. You can find her here:
https://corruptedunicorn.neocities.org/

Special Thanks to Haffey for testing console compatibility of v1.0!
Special Thanks to Charro64!

____________________________________

CHANGES IN V2.0:
- 120 custom animations. +30 minor adjustments to existing animations.
- Color Preset system.
- Replaced Silver Coin target marker with an actual reticle taken from Yoshi's story.
- Improved Targetting: Auto-aim is now based on Birdo's Head Position instead of her whole body's, which allows for more precise shots at enemies.
- Eggs can now interact with "Secret" spots (e.g. Wet Dry World "Secrets in the Shallows & Sky").
- Egg maximum travel distance has been doubled.
- Additional changes to in-game text.

You explore a sm64tified Gensokyo, trying to beat multiple bosses to unlock cap switches, keys and 2 of the badges from SR7/7.5.
The hack has an open world structure with interconnected levels and quiet a few branching paths.
Given the touhou theme, there are 2 extra stages hidden across the land, which can be unlocked close to the start of the hack. These require a password which can be acquired from SR6.9 or beating the final boss of this hack.

Story: After the events of SR7.5, a mysterious big star took hold of the Scepter of Faith and turned Earth into a Void, Mario now traversed Gensokyo to obtain enough star power to face this greater evil.

results.title: Antworks (Prototype)
results.description:
This is a prototype of the latest in-the-works project of Team Cornersoft. This project was started on the day of the Mario Jams Façade Competition and has prioritised its development to fulfill the theme of the competition. Yes this is both a competition entry as well as a proof-of-concept for what the project will eventually become.

What is Antworks about, you may ask?

Antworks is a game where you play as a worker ant who's gathering goods for their colony. You gain points for gathering food, and you can interract with other insects to get an idea of where to find it. The prototype does not have a time limit or any future mechanics we have planned, so, relax, take your time, and enjoy some Antworks~

Controls:
Control stick - move
A button - talk
Z button - grab/drop

Antworks (Prototype) was made during and produced for the Mario Jams Façade Competition 2023.

results.title: Sonic Mushroom Blast - Aquatic Ruins Demo
results.description:
Note: This is a mirror download for the SAGE 2024 demo of Sonic Mushroom Blast (patch file is identical to the one there and not updated at all). I will also provide a download for this on GameBanana.

Disclaimer: For best experience, play this hack with GlideN64 or ParaLLEl video plugins with FRAMEBUFFER ENABLED. I have not tested this demo specifically on any other emulator so your mileage may vary. This demo REQUIRES the expansion pak, however, the final game will not as this demo level will NOT be included in the final game.

After 2 years, a special 1-level demo for Sonic Mushroom Blast is here, with a original level inspired by Aquatic Ruins from Sonic 2 (Waterbound Western). This level boasts being the largest horizontal single area (without any fancy loading zones or level streaming tricks) level ever made in SM64, being 16x larger than a vanilla SM64 level (visually speaking, collision is only 8x).

This also serves as a tech demo for my custom lighting engine I've dubbed Hedgehog Engine 64, for it's ability to fake global illumination indirect lighting via the framebuffer. If you run this on an emulator that doesn't support framebuffer, the lighting engine will fall back to the older Lantern Engine 64 palette based static lighting system (which will still be used in some levels in the final game).

This demo contains 2 "stars" (fake chaos emeralds) and no 100 coin "star". 

Hope you enjoy, despite this being rushed for the SAGE 2024 deadline!

--Blake

results.title: Sonic Mushroom Blast: Legacy
results.description:
Notice: While this is technically a mirror for the SAGE 2025 download, this and the GameBanana release are newer than the SAGE 2025 release and feature content that was cut from that version due to time constraints. 
For best experience, use ParaLLEL or GlideN64 (the latter especially if you care about using the beta skin or wanna visit the Chao Clamor levels due to less z-fighting).

Sonic Mushroom Blast: Legacy is an iteration of my total conversion mod Sonic Mushroom Blast that's based off my original 2023 vision for the mod back when it was meant to be an ambitious character hack of the vanilla game, rather than fully remixed SM64 levels, enemies, items, etc. 
The mod features 123 stars total, (1 star in BOB is unattainable due to Sonic's moveset). 
There are 4 bonus courses hidden in the castle (the two aforementioned Chao Clamor stages, Stardust Speedway, and Emerald Hill Zone as a post-credits bonus). The 2 wing cap stages have been replaced with stages from Sonic R where you race Metal Sonic and collect Sonic R coins.

Since this is based off earlier builds of Mushroom Blast, the lighting engine and post-processing effects have been stripped back to their 2023 counterparts (no global illumination, no framebuffer effects), which behaves similarly to the lighting engine of SA1 (Lantern Engine). 
For SAGE 2026 I plan on giving this mod a 2.0 update which will add 2 more bonus stages as well as elemental shields to the game's sandbox.
This is not to be confused for the "flagship" version of Mushroom Blast as that will get a dedicated release some years down the line. 
This is comparable to a multiplatform game getting a last-gen or portable system port (where the game is completely different from the main flagship HD version).

Gameplay Tips:
The settings menu is equally as unfinished as it was in the 2024 Aquatic Ruins demo, this menu will get finished *eventually*.
Press B in the File Select to enter file deletion mode. Pressing B again will revert back to file selection mode.
Press D-Pad Down while idle to switch between the 2024 model and the 2023 beta model for Mushroom Blast Sonic.
Refer to signposts and NPCs in-game for further gameplay tips.

And yes, I did bite the "Legacy" part from Rovert's hack Interstellar: Legacy.

results.title: SM64 Redux - F3 Build
results.description:
'SM64 but better' but not in the way you'd think! This mechanical rework was designed so that every course can be completed on your first visit, with the exception of missions that require cap powerups. There's also additional elements of continuity ranging from simply charming to highly ambitious.

The act select screen has been completely removed, and each power star has configurable behaviors that suit their respective mission. The new Act Manager object can be loaded in to bridge the gap between level states. As a little bonus, I've added upgraded fixed warps that use a separate animation than deaths just for the sake of feeling polished.

I created this mod because I wanted to set a new baseline for romhacks. This version of SM64 is the best of both worlds, leaving the option to boot players out of levels while maximizing freedom of exploration, keeping the pace up, and still allowing for act progression.

I'll (eventually) port this mod to HackerSM64 and merge it with my currently unfinished analog camera mod so I can make my improvements public.

I planned to submit this mod to F3 but I didn't put a video together in time lol. Hopefully the improved player experience speaks for itself! I'd love for this mod to get plenty of attention so folks can improve their own hacks with these new features.

Credit to Kaze, specifically Peach's Fury, for inspiring the new star catch popups, dynamically updating pause menu, and course intros.

I've had this mod idea for over a year now, I'm proud of how it turned out and I'm happy for it to be my first publication on RHDC.

results.title: SM128 Divided by 4
results.description:
SM128 Divided by 4 (or SM32 if you do the math.) is... surely a romhack... I made this in the span of around 3 days, with only a couple of hours being spent on actually making it.

It features: Up to 32 MarioBots and a really boring "level".

Each MarioBot has 3 States: 
  - Wander;
  - Chase;
  - Flee.

Wander is the default state, where it jumps and runs around the stage.
After a while, the bot gets bored and begins to Chase around other bots. If a bot senses that it's being chased down, it will start its Flee state and run away from the chaser.

I might come back to this one of these days but for now that's it.

results.title: Abandoned Gardens - (B3313: Integer Limit DEMO)
results.description:
Finally, you have arrived. Circling the maze for what seems like an eternity, you finally found it: the garden that holds the remnants of that which came before. The sights ahead of you are overwhelming, but the chaos' embrace welcomes you, as you step into the gardens, abandoned and true. Will you uncover its secrets as you descend, or will you get lost, and find no end...

Welcome to Abandoned Gardens! An ambitious demo for the upcoming hack B3313: Integer Limit, also known as the a3 update for B3313: Unabandoned. Explore an elaborate hub comprised of around 50k triangles, connected together with seamless warps, for a experience that offers quantity, without compromising on quality. Being the largest and most ambitious area of B3313 history, take a tour of many sights within the Gardens, many fully original, but some also familiar to those with a keen eye on B3313 and its history, lovingly recreated to honour the past. We hope that Abandoned Gardens and all its levels will serve as a memorable glimpse of what is to come. All the content in this demo will be in the full release of B3313: Integer Limit.

v1 technically works on console, but is unplayable performance-wise and has a crash in a room. v2 supports console better, with around a average fps of 15-20 for Abandoned Gardens itself (and MUCH more regular performance for every other area included in this demo), a much more refined style, and extra goodies included!

results.title: Skycastle 64
results.description:
Do you have what it takes to find out what tragedy happened at Skycastle? Try uncovering the secrets around the sudden demise of the Skycastle civilization and their godess Velka. Who was behind all of this?

Skycastle is a short fun Kaizo experience with a huge focus on exploration, visuals and polish. Kaizo hacks can be so much more than a amalgam of random geometry and quicksand. 

This hack comes packed with 10 stars, a story with lore, a lot of custom code and fun challenges. No Kaizo BS like quicksand ledgegrab spam or 20ish red coins. In fact there are no red coins at all 😊

Nevertheless this hack is not aimed at Kaizo beginners. If you are new to Kaizo hacks, make sure to bring some patience.

If you find any bugs, feel free to contact me directly. I will try to fix any problem asap. Always use the newest uploaded version to get the best experience.

results.title: Takua 64 (Bionicle64)
results.description:
Takua 64 is a major total conversion mod for Super Mario 64 created by Superstupidy to bring the world of Bionicle into the N64 3D platforming era!

With environment and level design inspired by games like Metroid Prime, Tomb Raider, and of course, the many Bionicle games that had a huge influence on this game’s world.
MNOG,
MNOGII,
Bionicle the Game,
The Legend of Mata Nui,
and Tales of the Tohunga,
being primary examples.

With 99 “Toa Stones” to find and collect, Takua 64 is a very large romhack feturing 12 levels, each with multiple areas to explore and challenges to overcome.

Takua 64 is aimed at pleasing (hopefully) Bionicle fans with little to no SM64 experience as well as SM64 veterans with its difficulty.
I may have leaned a little hard towards the difficult end, especially starting somewhere in the middle of the game.

If you’re only really interested in seeing the game and the environments, but aren’t really interested in challenging yourself too much, savestates are definitely an option. There’s no shame in using them!
I’ll also have a full developer commentary on my Youtube channel of course, so if you need help figuring out how to beat a certain level, or if you just want to sit back and see the whole game, that option is available as well.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HG3eWC7zKNY&list=PLWe3kARRxOpt8DDIJB-gYAufOKrDm0Wxy


(GAME INFORMATION) (SPOILERS)



COINS:

Coins (or lightstones) are only really placed in the game for the sake of filling out the levels, guiding the player, and score.
No 100 Coin Stars.


ADVANCED TECHNIQUES:

This game will require a few SM64 speedrunning techniques, however, if you don’t know them, fear not! If I did my job correctly, you should be able to learn these moves from information in the game.

Examples of advanced techniques include:

Arial Kicks
Silly Kicking
Slide Kicking
Triple Jump Dive
BLJ


(CHANGELOG)
(v1.0) Added Music.
(v1.1) Minor collision fixes, Changed stardoor requirements, Added a couple of hint signs.
(v1.2) Many collision fixes, Minor grammar corrections, Removed confusing Kini-Nui Warp, Lava hub area death warps to Lava hub area.
(v1.3 Minor collision fixes. Each of the 7th Toa Strones now has a dedicated hint. Reworked the first Translator hint sign.
(v1.4) Fixed the Onu-Koro crabs.

results.title: IronMario 64
results.description:
IronMario 64 is a ROM hack based off the SM64 Randomizer to be used for attempting the IronMario Challenge, conceived by DGR_Dave. Inspired by the brutal difficulty of challenges like IronMon, IronMario pushes players to their limits by combining extreme randomization with a no-damage rule.

Official rule page: https://ironmario.xyz/

Join the IronMario discord! https://discord.gg/XGZvaQud6M

Base Rules:

* No Damage, Permadeath, No Caps, No Koopa Shell
* Extreme randomizer difficulty
* No exiting course from stages
* No re-entering a stage once you have entered another stage or collected the same star twice
* All 15 main courses have an extra ! Box that contains a Green Demon

You can play to obtain 70 stars, 100 stars, or even all 120 stars! If you attempt to get 120 stars, you will be able to choose to activate 2 of the 4 cap switches (including the shell) once you reach 100 stars.



If the Base rules are too easy for you, then you can try to get 70, 100 or 120 stars on the Hardcore presets! These have some additional rules:

* All courses have many additional enemies
* Some enemies move at double speed
* All 15 main courses have 2 Green Demon ! Boxes
* Mario's breath drains twice as fast underwater



In the IronMario Settings page, you can toggle door indicators, to make it more clear which doors in the castle are unlocked, and you can also enable or disable invincibility frames, to remove the chance of being spawnkilled upon entering a course.

This hack also features over a hundred new songs to be included with the Music Randomization option! You can also use the "Set as Default" button in the options page to quickly retry the challenge with your preferred settings.

Credits:
* Reonu for the title screen model

results.title: Servus 64
results.description:
A Classic-Based Hack, heavily inspired by LUGMILLORD's SM74 and SM74EE.

Your friend lost their wallet in this World. Because he is busy, you have to find and retrieve it for them. It's of great urgency, they might not attend to a Pizza Dinner without it! Will you be able to save it?

Features:
-141 Stars to collect (110 to Final Bowser)
-aglab2 cam patch
-Custom Bowser Fights (No ASM)
-some Custom Music
-mostly Vanilla Textured Levels
-Bonus Area

The Hack starts with basic difficulty (first levels like SM74), and then gets increasingly harder till the end (last levels like SM74EE). So, the later levels are only for advanced Players! If you are not too experienced with Super Mario 64, I recommend using Save-States - or else it can get quite frustrating.

Some Creator Notes:
This Project has been quite interesting. It started so long ago, at times where I just wanted to test SM64 Hacking itself, and find out how to make cool levels. But I always lost motivation, stopped and got something else to do. (Probably SMW Stuff xD)
But now I finally got it together and finished this game. So, here we are!

I learned so much more things about 3D Modelling, but also Hex-Editing, Patching and Comparing Data Differences, as well as Behaviour Scripting and more.
Most importantly, I discovered for myself how to make a Game more flowy, which I wasn't very good at before. I only used to focus on Tool-Assisted Speedruns, not regular Gameplay.
This Game is far from perfect, and seriously not very flowy at some points (Course 6 is the BEST Example for Clunky Gameplay!).
But some Stars do play great and I'm very satisfied with that!

I have also already received lots of Feedback from the Community already, and most of it was quite positive. It really makes me feel like my work paid off! :)

Lots of fun with the Hack!

Symptoms may include loss of consciousness (LOC); memory loss; headaches; difficulty with thinking, concentration, or balance; nausea; blurred vision; sleep disturbances; and mood changes. Any of these symptoms may begin immediately, or appear days after the injury. Concussion should be suspected if a person indirectly or directly hits their head and experiences any of the symptoms of concussion. results.title: Gravity Swap 64
results.description:
Gravity Swap 64 is a hack that rewrites a ton of the SM64 code in order to be able to support gravity in any direction. The hack comes with two main modes:

==== Normal Mode ====

Play through the 120 stars of the vanilla game, but the direction of gravity will swap to a random direction every 30 seconds! Plan your moves carefully around which direction gravity will swap to next and avoid being caught in a bad spot! (You can crouch in place to speed up the timer to avoid waiting.)

In the pause menu you can activate Freeplay Mode, which allows you to pause the 30 second timer and swap gravity at will, letting you freely mess around with the mechanic.

==== Challenge Mode ====

Play through 100 unique hand-picked challenges where you must traverse the levels while gravity is locked into a specific direction! There are a massive variety of difficulties so this mode will have something for everyone, from casual players to experienced kaizo completionists.

Your times in Challenge Mode are also saved, and you recieve rankings based on how fast you beat them. These rankings do not count towards your progress, but they provide a great additional challenge. How many S ranks can you get?

results.description:
Super Mario 64: High Quality Rom Hack is a reskin of Super Mario 64 with every track edited to either a funny melodyswap, or an arrangement of a song. All text boxes and most textures have been either slightly altered, or completely changed.

Yes, this rom hack is inspired by SiIvaGunner's 2016 SM64 album, Grand Dad 64 (it has less grand dad than grand dad 64).

During the mist of his repainting wrath, he went insane and convinced himself that he was "The King Of Pop (Michael Jackson). It's up to Mario to go up to the castle and stop Bowser and his delusion.

Lastly, there's an Original Soundtrack release! :) It includes some special stuff that you can't find in the game due to... limitations... So that stuff'll be in the OST version!

BandCamp Release: https://midnight04.bandcamp.com/album/super-mario-64-high-quality-rom-hack-original-soundtrack

(Note for Simple: Yoo wtf no File Select, Slider, Snow Mountain [Ending], Stage Boss, Metal Mario, and [the level] Tick Tock Clock reveal :(... It ok.}

results.title: Debug 64
results.description:
Debug 64 is a hack which uses the HackerSM64 and SM64 Debug Features.

In-order to enter the debug level select, hold L while the game is starting up. To select levels, use the D-Pad. To enter the level, press Start
In-order to enter the flying/free-move mode, press D-Pad Up while you are in a stage. To move Mario, use the analog stick. To move him up or down, use the D-Pad. To make Mario only rotate, hold Z while moving. To exit the flying/free-move mode, press A
In-order to toggle the debugger (or whatever you want to call it), press D-Pad Up while holding L.
In-order to switch modes in the debugger, press L and use the D-Pad to select the mode. Then press L again to switch to the mode.

results.title: Luigi Is Really Real
results.description:
NOTE FROM HACK UPLOADER (moist_mason)

As far as I am aware, this is the oldest known ROM Hack for Super Mario 64 in existence. At the very least, it was featured in the first Super Mario 64-related video uploaded to YouTube, on August 27, 2005. This hack replaces Mario with a custom Luigi model. It was recently featured in a Vinny stream from October 5, 2025, which is how I (and I’m assuming many of you) was made aware of it. 

All development credit goes to Starxxon (also known as VL-Tone), who has generously allowed me to convert and upload this hack here. This hack will not be updated beyond my initial upload. It is reuploaded here for preservation purposes, as I feel its significance to SM64 ROM hacking history necessitates it being made more accessible to a wider audience. Note that this is different from the later 2007 patch that was also made by Starxxon, and can also be found on RHDC.

This was released using the PPF patch format, so I had to convert it to BPS. This was not that tedious; all I did was create a z64 file from the PPF via Starxxon’s instructions (included in his original video description), and then used Flips to generate a BPS patch file.

results.title: Slide Home (demo)

This is my first standalone hack. I hope you enjoy what's here anyways. I plan to return to it at some point in the future to complete the whole thing.

NOTES:
- If you are using GLideN64, enabling LLE RSP will break the skyboxes.
- Be careful not to hit the walls in area 1 in midair because they are lava surfaces. There is one jump near the end of the first area where this can be a bit tricky.
- The hack ends with the vanilla end cake screen.
- All of the text is placeholder text.
- After finishing the hack, if you want to use cheats to fly around the areas, debug free move was left enabled (press up on the D-Pad). This is totally an intended feature that I didn't forget to turn off when submitting :). Puppyprint Debug is also enabled (press up on the D-Pad and L at the same time), which includes a level select (press L again then Dpad down to get to the level select). The levels are BOB, WF, and JRB, in that order. This will not work if you're on the ending cake screen.
- Mario model is from Yoshi Milkman.

Area 1: Celeste B-Sides: Mirror Temple

results.title: Super Mario 64(2)
results.description:
I first discovered this hack via a youtube video a long time ago, I remember wanting to play it on my wii badly but that never happened unfortunately. But two whole decades later I found a working build of the hack on the internet archive, this link specifically:
https://archive.org/details/super-mario-64-2-feyoshiparty
and i'm now reuploading it here on rhdc so it can be better preserved. shoutouts to Sunlitspace542528 for the original find.

Here's the original post description:

"Super Mario 64(2) by FeYoshiParty. Lost for a very long time. A hack most likely made with Toad's Tool 64. Contains new object layouts, texture swaps/replacements, modified level terrain settings, and custom music and dialogue. This was apparently intended for release as a Wii WAD (Virtual Console injection), however that file is either lost or unreleased. There are also mentions of a PSP version. This hack was apparently in development from 2007 to 2011."

I do not know the creation date, but going by the creator's first uploaded video on the hack, i set the creation date to October 26th of 2007. 
This build also doesn't seem to be the one from the video i first saw this hack from as it's missing the number 2 on the title screen, and it's missing elements from later videos on the creator's channel like edits done to Bowser in the Sky.

The exit course warp is also broken, so alongside the original unmodified rom I'll be uploading a hotfix patch of my own that fixes said broken warp and adds the 2 on the title screen back (last one's a nitpick of mine). If you find any major bugs in either versions let me know and I'll update the patched version.

results.title: The Junuary Project
results.description:
A hack that tries to implement as many pre-release and prototype assets into SM64, With some extra polish. 

Experience the stars of January '96 and other pre-release ones, and explore long forgotten test stages.
Surf on lava past Blarggs, toss back at Ice Tossya, and find the Yellow Koopa Shell Switch.

Utilize old and forgotten moves such as Dashing, Squat Kick, SSK Sideflip, and JumpStep3.

Includes several debug features such as a position display, restored level select, free move, Frame Advance, and a custom speed display.

Fully compatible with console, no expansion pack is required.

To activate level select, go to the title screen and press Z + Start at the same time.

To activate position display, do the same code as the level select in-game.

To activate free move, press L + R + Start while paused.

To squatkick press B when crouching.

To dash hold B and move the analog stick forward.

Pre-release English dialog is also included.

To activate the speed display, press L.

1/19/2023
Update 3.4.12: "Another Junuary"

Dashing now uses beta acceleration, meaning it will be slow at the start but faster at the end.
Heavily optimized math functions with code from HackerSM64, also collision optimization.
Enabled the 9 vertex shadows, which was disabled by the developers.
Changed two star names, "Small at Holm", and "Clocking in at the Peak"
Tossya no longer stutters when running, he now uses a dynamic run turn speed.
Metal Wing Box, hopefully fixed.
Moved some Yajima Land objects to subareas, mostly just the cap box duplicates.

7/19/2023
Update 3.4.13: "Snowfilled Wait"

Spindrift Model Changes, spindrift sound has been adjusted.
Ice Motos has been changed to resemble the Ice Bullies more.
SL Painting Snow Restored Snow/Blizzard has been fixed.
TTC Clock sound has been fixed to use the intended sound.
Bowser Fire now falls slightly differently.
Pathed Iron Balls now make movement noise.
Dice textures adjusted. RAM is now cleared on boot.
Additional Optimizations have been added.

10/2/2023
Update 3.4.14: "Console Compatible"

Spindrift model reverted to vanilla to fix crash in snow levels.
Upstairs crash is now fixed.
Bowser 3 now uses a red/orange floor to match b-roll footage.
Burn smoke now uses animated dust textures, making it save space, while also being accurate to Shoshinkai.
Adjusted a few sounds.

1/31/2025
Update 3.4.15: "Sunny Day"

Implemented Angry Sun
Changed sleeping particles to be white (matches Yoshi's Island)
Added giddywakeup (press A during the first sleeping animation)
Rolling Rocks in Cave Maze now break on impact with the player.
Removed an extraneous red coin in Desert Pyramid
Added slight RNG to the throwable dice in Yajima Land
Corrected the star name "Scowering the Sewers" to "Scouring the Sewers"
Tossya (Motosman) no longer bounces when dropping down.
The player can throws Tossya (Motosman) slightly farther.
Removed one Blargg by the volcano.
Blargg's collision and speed have been changed to make it more fair.
Updated Level Select Names (Stage 38: Cave Dungeon, Stage 25: EXT10 Cake, Stage 15: Fire Bubble2).
Firebubble2 added as a dummy stage.
Added some optimizations.
Updated the power meter.

results.title: Polymoveset
results.description:
A moveset test i made for SM64

Main moves:

-Triple Air Jump: Jump, press Z to do a Double Jump and then press A to do a Triple Jump in the air

-Cannon Dive: Press B while doing a Triple Jump to make a special dive (it doesn't work after talking with Yoshi). You can use this to go really high

-Long Air Jump: Press Z while doing a Backflip to do a Long Jump in the air

-Twirl: You can do a Twirl if you press B while doing a Side Jump or pressing B after a Wall Kick

-Box Kick: While holding a box, Jump and press B to do a Kick. This allows you to do other things without dropping the box. However, Mario will drop the box if you stay in the ground without jumping

Other changes:

-If you Jump in a slope and press B, Mario will do a Kick instead of a Dive

-If you press B while falling, Mario will do a Kick instead of a Dive

-If you press A just when grounding, Mario will do a Triple Jump instead of a Double Jump

Limitations:

-You can't Ground Pound in a Normal Jump nor a Double Jump, but you can do it in a Triple Jump

-You can't do a Cannon Dive after unlocking Special Triple Jump

-You can't Ground Pound while doing a Backflip

-You can't Dive after a Side Jump nor a Wall Kick

-You can't throw a box in the air

results.title: Single Shot 64
results.description:
A ROM hack made mostly for... myself, lol. Essentially SM64 with 1 health point, a few necessary changes for keeping it fair for people who are not considerably experiencied in SM64 and for accessibility in general plus a bit of personalization of my own.

Differences between the different versions are: the default version has no lives, neither has a Game Over. In contrast, the "True" variant limits your lives to 0, has a Game Over and your save file gets deleted each time you die. It was made in case the default version felt too easy.

My desire to make this came from when I was playing around with the concept of trial and error in other games by manually removing (or limiting) anything that gave me an extra chance of taking damage. Of course, Super Mario 64 wasn't designed with that in mind, but I wanted to see what would happen anyway!

results.title: Super Mario 64 1.5
results.description:
A Very old TT64 hack I've made back in summer 2012, I've done it in roughly one month. The main objective was to make the least blatant TT64 possible by moving most or all objects in
the levels. Including dialogues, stars, enemies, and especially coins which are very often unchanged from the vanilla game.
The 100 coins stars are way easier than the vanilla game.

It was initially just a private hack for myself that I shared with some IRL friends, but I finally
wanted to upload it for the lol as a meme hack.

During the following years, I've updated the hack mainly by changing the dialogs and the music. Which can explain why this 2012 hack has some recent music.

But I have to warn you : it's full of private jokes and other things like that, I've tried to change them among the next years to make them more "public"

Don't expect it to be good though, or even mediocre at most, but I'll let you make your own opinion. Just don't be surprised of some bad design choices :)

results.title: Super Mario Kindergarten
results.description:
This hack is an old hack created by Crashdance22 on YouTube back in 2007 for his Machinima of the same name. Sadly, on December 31, 2019 Crashdance22 deleted his entire YouTube channel in response to the COPPA situation going on at that time, but not before backing up his videos to MEGA. However, until April 14, 2025, any download links to this hack were lost. I had the unedited rom back up on an old USB stick and had decided to upload it online for preservation for all to enjoy. I have also posted 2 other versions that were edited from the original rom that include various fixes to the music and dialogue to make it a more polished experience, and to make both versions as accurate as possible to the Machinima itself. I also made 2 other versions that add VL-Tone's Luigi model just for the fun of it. Aside from creating a version with Luigi and the various fixes to the hack, I don't take credit for anything else. I know this hack is somewhat crusty and it is definitely a product of it's time, but it holds a special place in my heart and I simply wouldn't want this hack to become lost media.
Hope you enjoy it!
Note: As this hack was made to follow a scripted path, most of what isn't seen in the Machinima is unedited from the vanilla version of Mario 64. I recommend
you guys to watch the original Machinima
itself before playing this. Here's the link to the Machinima: https://youtu.be/5amPNEokqoU?si=LNR-Brwz-qTNYbMe

results.title: Dreaming Mario's Amalgamation (OW1 Demo)
results.description:
This is a demo of the first overworld of an upcoming hack named "Dreaming Mario's Amalgamation", made for Scuttle Hacking Competition 3, in which you had to make a "hack of a hack".

This demo includes 3 main courses (C1, C2 & C5) and 2 secret courses (WC & B1), as well as a custom overworld.

The making of this hack took about a full week (7 days) of actual work, although that is a very rough timeline since I was not keeping track of time during the making of the hack. However, most of the hack was made during the final week of the time given (the time given being November 19th 2021 to January 1st 2022; work on the demo officially started on December 3rd 2021, and concluded on January 1st 2022).

Every single one of the levels in the hack uses level models from other hacks combined with textures from levels in different hacks, hence the "amalgamation". It's meant to hopefully bring back familiar locations to the player. The hack originally came with a .txt that contained the original authors of everything, but this is not included in the download. An update will be made to include the credits in-game eventually, but for now here they are:

- Dream Towers (model from "Lug's Tiny Torture" by Lugmillord, textures from "Star Revenge 2 (Act I): To the Moon" by BroDute, music by jesusyoshi54)
- New Sunrise (model from "SM64 The Unknown Courses" by goldirehead789, textures from "Ztar Attack 2: A Blast to the Past" by TheGael95, music from "SM64 Stellato" by Rulu & Itsri).
- Gardens of Hope (models from "Super Mario The Crystal Stars" by Fares242 & "Luigi and the Forest Ruins Rebooted" by LinCrash & TheGael95, textures from "Star Revenge 6.25: Luigi's Adventure DX" by BroDute & "Stars of the Beast 2.5" by Milgram355 & Daniel_EDC, music by mosky2000)
- Penguin's Sky (model from "Super Mario Jammin Journey" by goosedajuice, textures "The Phantom's Call" by PhantomPhire, music from "Mario Adventure" by aglab2)
- Previous Location (model from "SM64 Luigi's Ghostly Quest" by SonicAndMarioGames, textures from "I Crave Attention 64" by aglab2 & lunhazel, music from "Mario Adventure" by aglab2)
- Unliving, Fading Diadem (model from "TB8's Classic Pack" by TomatoBird8, textures from "King Boo's Revenge 2" by thebloody7 & sizzlingmario4, music from "Super Mario Integration of Fragments" by various people).

Although this may end up being one of the simpler entries due to its premise and my lack of much experience, I hope it's still at least enjoyable to playthrough.

results.title: Super Mario 64 3D
results.description:
Experience Super Mario 64 like never before, now in anaglyphic 3D!


Important Hack Notes:
  • This hack is fairly resource intensive and may not run well on lower-end machines. Each image needs to render twice as often as in the vanilla game, so the recommended plugin for use is GlideN64. However if your PC can handle it, Angrylion is the true recommended plugin of choice.
  • This hack requires framebuffer emulation! Please use a plugin that supports it, or the 3D effect will not work.
  • 3D is not supported on console or any emulator that isn't compatible with the instant-input patch.
  • In order to experience the 3D effect, you must possess a pair of red/cyan anaglyphic 3D glasses.


Additional Hack Features:
  • Widescreen support (press R in the pause menu)
  • Real-time adjustability of default 3D settings using the D-Pad

results.title: Arc of the Sky Wand (Demo) Revision 1
results.description:
EDIT: Hack has been tested using Ares, Project 64 v1.6, Retroarch (PL), etc. It appears some emulators do not support my asm hack to change music on instant warp.

AUTHOR NOTES (edited): Unfinished hack that somewhat exaggerates vanilla SM64 gameplay. Demo is here for playtesting purposes and feedback. Currently only one hub and three full levels (B1 added late). All cap switches are available, but any other courses outside the scope are unfinished. Also, for your information, the Tommy and DS Dorrie models are rips, NOT my work. Includes textures ripped from Bomberman 64: TSA.

Bowser has snuck away from the Mushroom Kingdom after his latest defeat. Instead of another kidnapping, Bowser turned to the unnamed kingdom he dubbed, Skywhere, a place he now rules over. Guess who brought all his baddies with him and, by using the power of the Sky Wand, repurposed many into decoys? Skywhere is Bowser's new playground as he produces his sky-dropping ideas into new traps for the fellows down below. Can Mario put an end to his new threat?

(March 1, 2026) DEMO UPDATE 1: Added the first Bowser course and battle. Hopefully by next update I'll have World 4 finished, but for now you can have another side course.
Tweaked the camera to allow centering to Mario's position (functionality during other camera types is limited rn). Lakitu camera allows more angle control.
Replaced the global 100-coin missions with side quests, which may or may not include occasional 100-coin missions...
Sandy Falls and Glacier Peaks now got a custom music theme (cave area music is unchanged for now). Red Coin Challenge theme is replaced with DDD alt instrument set, for now, which HOPEFULLY does not crash for anyone (fingers crossed, I didn't have any issues on my end).
Texture improvements and fixed a few issues, including Klepto getting stuck against the mounds.
The Key Door will take you to the ending cake screen for now until I design the second hub.
Also, modified cutscene for new file intro.
Changed the void color on the title screen.
VC course uses free roam camera now, and changed the music theme.
Misc. changes to level layout, some more shade smooth (not done with shade smoothing, however, particularly in Sandy Falls), etc.

As far as console compatibility, there is a rare issue where collision gets wonky on boot, but reloading the problem level will fix it.

KNOWN ISSUES: >Collision bug as mentioned above.
>Camera gets stuck in flying mode if entering a warp hole without landing.
>Wrong camera type after death warp from Bowser fight.
>Glacier Peaks theme has the sleigh bells using the wrong key, this will be fixed in the next update.
>Wrong UV mapping of a texture on one of the walls in the hub area.
>Unlikely to happen, but there is an oversight in UPDATE 1 that may render Mario's cap impossible to recover if you drop it oob in B1.
>See top EDIT.

COMING IN Demo REV 2...
More star catch cutscenes.
Second hub. Unfinished levels get hype.
A few more custom music themes.
A few course extensions, including at least one new Star to find (new count: 55?).
Enemy additions, including Buzzy Beetles and slightly revised Spinies.
8-direction camera will be compatible with the cam position lock.
More level geometry corrections.
Text or dialog corrections.
Limit camera spinning to Mario's back when in motion.
C1 S2 sidequest bug fix.
Hi Score ribbons.
Max HP changes (and optimizations).
Extra fluff (you'll notice).
Increased render distance for level models, introducing some extra scenery.
Some in-game credits.
Custom cutscenes for important dialogue, details, etc.
A few enemy nerfs (including the owl's horizontal speed) and some layout changes.
Mid-game optional lost-and-found gimmick.
Extra coins for combos.
Less lag for a few areas.
No 100-coin side quests.
So many changes, I can't fit them into a list anymore.

COMING IN full hack:  >World 4.
>"Special version" of all four worlds.
>Finished second hub.
>Possible custom miniboss addition(s).
>Custom credits sequence.
>The three "forbidden" courses.
>Sticker sidequest.
>Any other edits requested after REV 2.

results.title: Super Mario 64 XXL
results.description:
Super Mario 64 XXL is a gameplay alteration of SM64, heavily inspired by Sonic 2 XL. Mario has a fitness meter, which slowly improves if you avoid chocolate coins, but drops very quickly if you do eat them, which will lead you to a very fast demise. The game also features a custom pause menu made from scratch, works on console, and has bonus extras.

Features:
Toggle-able Fitness Meter with the Press of the L Trigger!
*Dynamic weight gain/loss system that'll scale Mario appropriately and alter his physics accordingly
*Brand new pause menu to accommodate for the extra features
*Cheats, such as LSD and DK Mode
*Widescreen toggle for those playing in Project64 and want a 16:9 skybox
*Console Compatibility, no expansion pak required!
*Some minor tweaks like red coins not counting as coins, endcake that brings you back to the splash screen, etc

Made with SM64 Decompilation Project.

Mario Land is once again, under attack!! This time, Bowser's casted another curse over the castle and he and his troops have been going around the Mushroom Continent causing mayhem, stealing Power Stars and crushing anything and anyone who gets in their way! Mario and friends just so happened to be visiting Mario Land for a celebratory vacation when they caught wind of the Koopa chaos. It is now up to Mario reclaim his kingdom and liberate the rest by hunting down the lost Stars! Only then, will he have the strength to take down Bowser!

Celebrating 30 years of one of the greatest video games of all time with 30 Stars from my biggest, most polished SM64 project yet! Lost Golden Stars takes inspiration from various SM64 hacks as well as revives scrapped ideas of my own and content from unreleased projects. This is the hack I've wanted to make since 2020 and now I finally have the skills and resources to pull it off!

The finished project is planned to be a 120+ Star epic. With all-new creative stages, a beautiful presentation, fun and innovative mechanics, etc. As of releasing this demo, the game is roughly 12% complete and has been in development for just over three months. Tons more features and improvements are set to be added and I highly welcome you to check out the project and give your respective feedback.

For anyone curious about console compatiblity, while I don't have the equipment to test it, considering how large most of the stages are and the fact I enabled ROM Manager's RCVI Hack in order to reduce lag, I'm assuming it doesn't, unfortunately.

The demo contains four courses and two bonus Stars. This entire build is essentially a snapshot of what I currently have done. Credits are also listed in the game. I hope you enjoy it!

- Added options menu back

This hack was submitted as part of the "Dreams" Hack Competition.

The Talisman is a short exploration through the strange dreams of Mario.

Mario thoroughly enjoys his adventure. Just going from dream to dream, without a care in the world...

This hack is very short. It focuses on story, rather than gameplay. For the full experience, try and talk to everyone that you can.
This hack includes some themes that may cause stress to some. Player discretion is advised.
Thank you for taking time to play my hack.

results.title: Brave Mario 64 - Vanilla RPG
results.description:
"Over a year of work and months of lost sleep went into this remake of my latest hack. Now that I think I have added enough new custom mechanics and cool stuff, plus with several crashes fixed (some rather obscure ones too, which I missed before), I guess it is time to share this thing."

Replay the vanilla Super Mario 64 with various new ways to experience the game. Now with more RPG-staple elements than the past hack, you can upgrade Mario's status with FOUR different stats, check your items in the upgraded pause menu, change your username, enemy item drops, and more! 

NEW FEATURES:
>New Item check menus.
>The Special Switches are now in every level. Less backtracking or other shenanigans.
>Expanded assortment of items, which can now be used manually.
>A secret alternate ending. Can you find it before it's too late?
>Flag items that can alter the game experience.
>CHAIN EXP. (Why on earth did I not think of this before?) Defeat enemies in succession to multiply the experience gained by the number of consecutive kills.
>An all-new custom level that can be unlocked at 120 Stars.
>No more 100-coin Stars. Instead you will receive a star piece for every 50 coins.
>A bestiary item that enables checking the description of various entities and animals, including strategies.
>A new Moxie stat that upgrades some of Mario actions.
>50 Silver Stars hidden among the courses and hub world. What might these be for? There are 2 in most courses and 4 in the main hub.
>New Warp Pads for faster travel from point to point within the same world. Ditching the obscure warp menu with limited warp points, now you have up to 9 warp locations per level!
>A username entry for each file. Talk to the MIPS in front of the castle to enter a name for the file select, up to 9 characters long.
>A new, optional transformation late in the game. Adds a new move at the cost of extra damage and halved attack power.

Changelog:
Rev 1: Fixed Chain Exp getting delayed. Removed reset bars.
Rev 2: Fixed unhandled opcode (bad branch) when attempting to ground pound during flying triple jump without unlock. Corrected the WF/CC star doors.
Rev 3: Fixed Pokey parts giving more EXP than intended. Moved a moneybag for less frustration, swapped some Snifits to be less annoying. Improved the branch changed in Rev 2.
FINAL fix: Boost item drop chances. Moved the green key in THI because it was too low. Added a few cutscenes to introduce stats. Added a cap icon to the course check in case you lose track of your hat. Cap'tain Mulligan takes effect instantly unless the cap is loose in the same course as Mario. Reduced wallet cap to 9999. Added a coin to guide the player to Whomp King's star. Also, Play Time bugfix. Player position is saved as long as Mario is standing on safe ground.
EDIT: Reuploaded due to missing cap icon conditions (CCM).

Forgot to mention anywhere that the Fast Enemy code is a near-replica of Dudaw's code.

results.title: A Song For Her
results.description:
Made for Simpleflips Musical Hack competition in June 2021. This short hack is all about Bowser Helping Mario to win Peaches Heart through Music. 

Please bear with me as this is my first hack, and I had MANY constraints, & issues. I hope to improve as a developer as time goes on. Thank You for your Patience & Understanding.

Features:
~Camera does not snap to Mario's back
~Stars Do not eject you from the level
~NO RED COIN
~NO 100 COIN
~NO BOSS FIGHT
~NO OPENING CUTSCENE (Pick a File and Begin)
~Colored Text Boxes
~Small bit of Humor

Down Side:
Player will have to jump into Bob-Ombs Battlefield Painting, as I was having issues setting up a proper warp. Sorry about that :(

I hope you have as much fun playing it as i did making it, this was new and a ton of fun to make. Thank You Guys!

results.title: Flip Flop Factory
results.description:
A short hack originally intended for Mario Jams 8: Flipped, however I was late joining and took a while to finish.

The main "gimmick" of this hack is that each time you enter a pipe the stage is "flipped" to a new side, though the acid remains at the new bottom of the course... However this idea is practically unused as the gameplay would be completely unaltered if you flattened out the course into a single plane-geometry as other sides are both ignored and so far separated that you couldn't interact with it if you wanted too.

Features 2 stars: 1 main star for making it to the "top" of the factory, and a bonus Vanish Cap wall jumping section

results.title: Disaster Quest 𝛑
results.description:
Please play our rom hack we think it is very funny and has a lot of really good jokes.

DQ𝛑 was a project that was originally supposed to be a 182 star hack created in a single day in order for us (Hoppiper26 and AprilSR) to become more familiar with rom hack creation tools - while at the same time experimenting with some weird rom hack ideas that might be out of place in a more traditional hack. 

The game did end up growing much beyond that initial plan, but I would still recommend not going into the hack with too many expectations. It might have more rough edges than most hacks. You also might have a better experience if you use savestates.

Although the hardest stars do reach significantly kaizo difficulty, you can get enough stars to beat the game (120) without doing anything especially awful.

We hope you have fun, and shoutouts to Simpleflips.

(Note from Cavin856: I actually had nothing to do with the creation of this hack)

(Note from April: yeah you did you modelled part of one of the courses)

(Note from Cavin856: that doesn't count, you stole my level after asking me for it)

results.title: Brollin' (BRLLR/Broller)
results.description:
Brollin' is an advanced plexus-themed beta rom hack made entirely in binary, recreating the b-roll build's physics and appearance to near perfection while offering some Quality of Life tweaks to make it slightly more fun to play in general 

(originally created for my own sm64 arg series, though it's an actual playable thing now.)

This is the culmination of various places, anomalies, and sightings found in the 1995/07/29 build, and as such is merely an imitation of it, research at your own risk. 

Don't expect the lore of the rom hack to reveal itself instantaneously, it's really spread out, the point of making it segmented is that some areas can simply feel off without any indication that something would be wrong.


random side note here: the demo versions crash when approaching the castle on a summercart for weird reasons, so i guess this is slightly console compatible as it doesn't actually lag, it just crashes.

results.title: Super RPG Mario 64 - A Vanilla SM64 RPG-esque Experience
results.description:
**If you have trouble booting/starting the ROM/game, you might not have 16kB EEPROM set on the ROM**


Play in the original SM64 world except Mario has adjustable Attack, Defense, and HP. Gain experience by defeating enemies and collecting Power Stars, then level up Mario to unlock his moves; at higher levels his moves update and some enemies will emerge.

Features:
New items that heal Mario or change his stats and status.
Coins can be kept to shop for items.
Collect 48 keys to open special Treasure Chests.
Save points that remember Mario's last position.
Easily return to starting points or checkpoints using the Warp Menu.
Dynamic NPCs. Watch King Bob-omb disappear, Koopa the Quick appearing in only one level a time, etc.
A new post-game with different dialogues and events.
Game Stats now unlock badges and special powers when meeting secret criteria.

Initial release (V1.0) boots on accurate emulation and hardware, but is currently unstable and may crash. Try not to use File D as that is when I experienced the most crashes. Also, I am currently aware that Eyerok may not hand out exp properly. This may be changed in v1.1.
EDIT: v1.1 UPDATE: Stat adjustments at newgame. Ukiki nerf. Eyerok was already fine, lol.
v1.2 UPDATE: Some QoL changes, and removed a wind blowing instance that was too close to blowing the cap OoB. Previous update may have been submitted wrong, but hopefully this one went through. 
v1.3 UPDATE: Changed a few Fwoosh positions to (hopefully) prevent crashing. Klepto moves less frequently. Added an item near the PSS end sign to attract attention. Adjustments to HP increases at levelup.
EDIT: v1.3 reuploaded due to a crash.
v1.4 UPDATE: Changed the wind direction & position in JRB. Brought PSS sign closer to platform. A coin bugfix. Capless damage only happens if hit while capless, not continuously during hp drainage. Anything else I may have forgotten (shortterm memory).
EDIT: Found two bugs recently, gonna prepare revision 5. New game+ seems to contain a death softlock, and rarely save stars delete when approached.
REV 5: Death softlock MIGHT be fixed,  at least changed the code responsible. Attempted to fix the disappearing save star issue. As a bonus for downloading, now includes a stat display for number of times you saved the game.
EDIT: Uh, doesn't softlock anymore but does break Mario spawn point (on File C it seems)
REV 6: Spawn point bug most likely fixed (a variable was set unexpectedly when saving sometimes). Klepto grabbing a loose cap in quicksand now removes the loose cap. File D console bug may never get fixed as I am probably moving on now.
REV 7: Urgent end-of-game crash fix. Other slight tweaks. Finally fixed duplicate caps when Scuttlebug snatches one off the ground and Mario touches it same frame.
REV 8: Shortened Fwoosh wind reach. Klepto y-anchor tweak. Miscellaneous position changes.
REV 9: Replaced a Fwoosh with a Monty hole. Tweaked blown back speed and timing when Mario's cap falls. New Game PLUS now doubles yellow and red coin values and doubles most enemy damages, etc.
REV10: Held cap bugfix. QoL changes from feedback. At this rate I'll have 10 revisions of the same hack, oh wait, I do.
EDIT: Lmao I was so tired I left a typo that crashed when leveling up. Should be fixed now. Resent update.

ENGLISH :

Is a Super Mario 64 Romhack (Mini Hack)
the first actual SM64 romhack I've been working on so far
it contains 30 stars :
1 PLANET EXPLORATION - 7 stars
2 LOST IN THE COSMOS - 7 stars
3 A BREATH OF POISON - 5 stars
4 CALM WORKOUT - 5 stars
5 WING CAP - 3 stars
Overworld stars - 3 stars
it takes approximatively 1h~ to finish, depending on how good you are at the game, I advise to use savestates, it'll make the experience better overall 

It features An original stars concept :

Green Stars : hidden star in the level
Blue Stars : same as the Green ones, but harder (and unique)
Red Stars : Wing cap stars (stars that needs the wing cap, there are 2)

FRANCAIS : 

SM64 - QCStars est une Romhack Super Mario 64 (Mini Hack)
Ma première réel romhack.
Il y a un total de 30 étoiles
1 PLANET EXPLORATION - 7 stars
2 LOST IN THE COSMOS - 7 stars
3 A BREATH OF POISON - 5 stars
4 CALM WORKOUT - 5 stars
5 WING CAP - 3 stars
Overworld stars - 3 stars

J'estimerais la durée du jeu à 1h~ même si ça dépend beaucoup de votre niveau, et des choses comme les savestates (que je vous conseil d'utilisez au passage, des fois certains sauts sont assez technique donc ça rendre l'expérience globale meilleur).


Ce à quoi vous attendre > Un nouveau concept avec des étoiles colorés :

Etoile Vertes : caché dans le niveau
Etoile Bleue : même concept que la verte, mais Il y en a qu'une par niveau et c'est plus dur
Etoile Rouge : étoile Wing cap (étoile qui nécessite la wing cap, il y en a 2)

Je continuerai le romhacking de mon côté, soit une nouvelle hack, soit je mettrais celle-la à jour, je verrais bien : ' )

results.title: Super CraziiCueva 64 (read Desc)
results.description:
this is my very first, unfinished hack. it is based and dedicated to a discord server of a youtuber i used to be on, called "CraziiCueva"
every level has a name of a user that was on the server and is dedicated to them, following a specific request they gave me. since this mod was my very first experience with 3d modelling and moding, there are a lot of errors and jank in the first few levels. 
to access the levels, in the room you appear in, if you see some white wall, that wall has 4 teleporters to 4 different levels, the reason it's a white wall is because there's supposed to be some profile pictures representing each user the level is made for (the whole hack is discord themed lol) but for some reason they bugged out and don't properly show in this emulator (they used to in project 64).
every text i replaced is in full spanish, since the server was mexican.
there is a specific star that takes place in a completely black room and a sign gives you instructions to follow, but since they're in spanish, i will say that all you have to do is go forward, hit a wall, try single jumping, if you can't then turn right, if you can then keep going forward until hitting a wall, then repeat.
there are 32 stars, 4 levels and 2 secret levels, no end credits or bowser fight. reminder that you have a secondary mario cam for interiors, recommend google translate for some stars, hope you enjoy this janky mess.

results.title: Super Mario 64 Ruby (Build 1)
results.description:
This is an early build of an old SM64 ROM hack I worked on when I was young. This is the 1st one, the 2nd being created in 2020. Occasional progress on this hack ranged from when I was 13 up until I was 16.

This build is very archaic and is not recommended if you are looking for an actual decent platforming experience: It is mainly here out of interest and archival. SM64 Ruby was intended to be a 120 star hack, but such goals never came to fruition.

Levels replaced: Bob-Omb Battlefield, Whomp's Fortress, Secret Aquarium, Jolly Roger Bay, Cool Cool Mountain (Heavily unfinished, lacks objects).

The console compatible patch was created with a simple fix from Plunger64. From my testing (Everdrive 64 X7), it runs relatively well.

I have gotten best results with Glide64, however, experiences may vary.

results.title: IP Location
results.description:
Aka STUPID IP LOCATION BALLZ

As information piles up, falsehood inevitably ensues. In 2022, in order to tackle the chaos of misinformation, a mysterious power was implemented to monitor locations and societies. The data produced by the population are labelled with particular locations and societies. Hence IP Locations are widely displayed. And then the world has been phasing into the second chaos.
So far, the problem is going pronounced than before. It is more difficult and intricate to solve. More mendacity is inflicted on humans. These humble creatures are going to surrender to the tech's sublime force. The force creates the block for them. They are stuck. They are overwhelmed. Their memories are altered. Finally, they loathe to distinguish between true and false. They are loath to participate in the solution.
As Mario looks at the scene, he decides to stop the power from being greater and greater again.
Make Ass Great Again!

My hack is evolving into Super Kaizo

This super kaizo hack I made with Sketchup is reflected in displaying IP location widely since 2022 (one year after the release of Deltarune 2♥, Toby Fox's game which tells about the adventure in the cyber world) for the public. It is meant to reminisce about the once-no-revelation cyberworld and this phenomenon is exposed to everyone.🤬

This hack features:
- Infinite lives
- Deltarune 2 music (2022)🤖
- practicing walljump, slope climbing, slope jump, quicksand ledge grab jump, momentum jump and pause buff (unnecessary)🤢

Plan to do
2025 anniversary level (maybe from FM C8)
2d level (maybe Celeste - Confronting Myself and Summit)
fast level (maybe from SR4.9 EotBM)

(3)

I will continue to make different anniversary IP location hacks till the cancellation of public display of IP location!
If the IP Location display were ended, I would release my final IP hack!
